description: Verify caller trust from real-time Cloudflare edge signals (TLS, HTTP protocol, geo, ASN). Returns a 0–1 trust score. Bot detection / KYA / handshake verification at $0.005 per call.

_signals.x_guidance: All endpoints accept GET. On first call without an X-PAYMENT header you will receive a 402 with x402 accepts payload. Settle the USDC payment on Base (eip155:8453), then re-call with the X-PAYMENT proof header. Quantum Shield can return its payload encrypted to your ML-KEM-768 public key when supplied via X-Buyer-ML-KEM-Public-Key header.
